other_text: "They say... A butterfly that flaps a wing right here can cause a storm in the Atlantic... So every one of us is like that butterfly, but with a difference... Our butterfly does not cause storms. It opens its wings and stands against them!"
description: Movie poster features a man in formal attire with outstretched arms, flanked by two shadowy figures. Text highlights themes of individual impact and resistance.
